name: Action Link proofs of concept
description: Experimental proof-of-concept Action Link State Action plugins (add-to-cart and subscribe) plus a demo page that renders them; not intended for production.
project_description: Experimental proof-of-concept submodule of Action Link. Ships two demo State Action plugins: poc_add_to_cart (a repeatable add/remove counter stored in Drupal state) and poc_subscribe (a toggle subscribe/unsubscribe stored in Drupal state, keyed by entity type + id). A controller route /action_link_poc renders link sets for these plugins against node 1. Marked experimental; the plugins are explicitly incomplete demos and are not intended for production use.
